notes.title: UPDATE (LAST IN EARLY ACCESS)
notes.content:
Last update in Early Access and last chance for Early Access price.
Changes:

+ 14 levels (50 in total)

+ new game play objects
-> fans

+ new bonuses:
-> flip screen (and invert controls)
-> fan activator (coins can not fall down)

+ points balanced

+ fixed old levels

+ fixed coins collisions

Official end of Early Access: 30.09.2019

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
+ 15 new levels (36 in total)

+ new game play objects:
-> teleports
-> black wholes
-> enemy guns and plasma guns
-> flying enemies

+ new bonuses (in level map)
-> increase and decrease enemy fire rate

+ old levels and gathering points balanced

+ graphic changes

+ improvement in physics and coins gravity
